highlights.headline: Danube water levels: Hungary, Romania cut nuclear output
highlights.summary: Historically low water levels along Europe's second-longest river have led Hungary and Romania to reduce output at key nuclear plants. Danube tourism and river cargo have also been severely affected by Europe's heatwave.

items.title: EU aims to build AI gigafactories of its own
items.description: The EU has unveiled a plan to raise state and private funds to hyperscale AI capabilities and gain independence from non-European governments. The plan calls for the construction of seven new sites across the bloc.
